candidates.citation_sentence: One exception is the study by Reiter et al. [62].
candidates.notes: Paper cites Reiter et al. as [62] but the actual Reiter et al. (2017) reference is [63] in the reference list. The replication replicated the ToM accuracy decline but did not replicate the ToM reaction time effect from the original. Paper cites Reiter et al. as [62] but the actual Reiter et al. paper is reference [63] in the reference list; reference [62] is Sze et al. (2012). The described original study matches Reiter et al.
